description: Use when benchmarking hospital supply chain efficiency against CMS peer cohort or building a materials management cost reduction case. Returns supply cost as percentage of operating expense at p25/p50/p75 by bed size and state. Example: 200-bed community hospital — supply cost 19.4% of operating expense vs 16.8% peer median — closing the gap to median recovers $2.6M annually at $130M operating budget. Source: CMS HCRIS cost reports. $0.02 USDC per call.
name: get_hospital_supply_chain_benchmark
title: Get Hospital Supply Chain Benchmark
